item.title: Overview of 2 Samuel – The Story of David
item.description: Adapted from insights by Ray C. Stedman and other biblical reflections_ A Story to Begin # Imagine a young leader named Aaron. He never sought power, but circumstances pushed him forward. People trusted him. God seemed to be shaping him. And for a while, everything went beautifully: victories, unity, purpose. But leadership has a way of exposing the heart.
